originalSourceText:
7. During the  training of a Regression Tree, a  test condition
    partitions the training data. At a particular leaf node (terminal
   node), the following 5 training instances are grouped together
   based on their target values 𝑦= [12,15,18,20,25].
    If a new test sample follows the decision tree rules and lands in
    this leaf node, its predicted target value 𝑦̂ will be _________.
   Answer: 18.0
   Refer to Lecture 29: Introduction to Decision Trees and Random
   Forests Slide 8

   For Regression tree: prediction is the mean (average) of the
    training instances that fall within that specific region (leaf node)


                                  12+15+18+20+25   90
   Predicted Value 𝑦̂ = 𝑚𝑒𝑎𝑛(𝑦) =         =  = 18.0
                                           5           5
